track_sequence_with_progress_bar: use track to iterate over a sequence while displaying a rich progress bar with description and total
track_sequence_without_total: use track to iterate over a sequence with a progress bar when the total count is unknown
disable_progress_bar_globally: set disable_progress_bar to True to disable all progress bar output across the module
track_on_main_process_only: use track_on_main_process to show a progress bar only on the main process in distributed training
customize_global_progress_columns: modify global_progress to add or remove columns like BarColumn or TimeRemainingColumn
